# list-table-options

Opt-in table behaviour of a list: remembered search/sort/filters, one reset button, column picker with hidden columns, row density, server-side groups with sums, a totals row and a number range facet.

## README

# List table options

Opt-in table behaviour for entity, projection and related lists. A list without
the `table` block renders and behaves as before.

## What it shows

- `table.rememberState`: search, sort, page size, facets and date range survive
  leaving and re-entering the list within the browser session.
- `table.resetAll`: one button resets everything that differs from the defaults.
- `table.columnPicker`: the view menu lets the user hide and reorder columns;
  `hidden: true` on a column starts it hidden.
- `table.density`: row density default and an optional user choice.
- `table.pinning`: the user pins columns left or right in the view menu;
  `pinned: "left"` on a column starts it pinned.
- `table.resizing`: columns can be resized (table-layout fixed); `width` and
  `minWidth` on a column are start values in px.
- `table.keyboardNavigation`: rows are one tab stop, arrow keys move between rows,
  Space selects the focused row.
- `table.export`: an Export button downloads the whole filtered list as an XLSX
  file; `maxRows` lowers the default limit of 10000 rows.
  Reference columns export their label and timestamps use the browser time zone.
- `bulkActions`: row checkboxes and a selection bar. "Delete" runs the delete
  row action once per selected row; done tasks are skipped.
- `table.grouping`: the server groups the list by status; each header shows the
  group's count and estimate sum, "done" starts collapsed and the view menu
  offers grouping by priority or none.
- `table.totals`: a footer row with the estimate sum over the filtered list.
- `facets.estimateHours: { display: "range" }`: from/to inputs for a number field.
- The same block on a `projectionList`, and `task:workload`, a hand-written list
  query that keeps grouping and totals by accepting `aggregate`
  (`entityListSchema`) and answering it with `answerListAggregate`.

## Source

Feature entry point: `src/feature.ts`.

## Tests

```bash
cd samples/recipes/list-table-options
bun test
```

The test boots the feature through the boot validator and checks that a
misspelled key, a hidden column without the picker, an unknown density, a pinned column
without `pinning`, a width without `resizing` and a bulk action on a navigate
row action are rejected.
`workload.integration.test.ts` runs the hand-written query over HTTP and checks
the grouped sums and the filtered total.

### src/__tests__/feature.test.ts

```ts
import { describe, expect, test } from "bun:test";
import {
  createRegistry,
  defineFeature,
  validateBoot as validateBootRaw,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/engine";
import type { ListTableOptions } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/ui-types";
import { withBootValidatorFixture } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-testing/helpers";
import { createTaskBoardFeature, openAccess, taskEntity } from "../feature";

// The boot validator is the net for blocks the type system never sees (JS, generated features).
function featureWithBlock(block: object) {
  return createTaskBoardFeature(block as ListTableOptions);
}

function validateBoot(features: Parameters<typeof validateBootRaw>[0]): void {
  validateBootRaw(withBootValidatorFixture(features));
}

describe("list-table-options recipe", () => {
  test("the full table block boots and reaches the registered screen", () => {
    const feature = createTaskBoardFeature();
    expect(() => validateBoot([feature])).not.toThrow();
    const screen = createRegistry([feature]).getScreen("task-board:screen:task-list");
    expect(screen?.type === "entityList" ? screen.table : undefined).toEqual({
      rememberState: true,
      resetAll: true,
      columnPicker: true,
      density: { default: "comfortable", userChoice: true },
      pinning: true,
      resizing: true,
      keyboardNavigation: true,
      export: { xlsx: true, maxRows: 5000 },
      grouping: { field: "status", collapsedWhen: "done", userChoice: true, fields: ["priority"] },
      totals: [{ field: "estimateHours", kind: "sum" }],
    });
  });

  test("the bulk action resolves to the delete row action", () => {
    const screen = createRegistry([createTaskBoardFeature()]).getScreen(
      "task-board:screen:task-list",
    );
    expect(screen?.type === "entityList" ? screen.bulkActions : undefined).toEqual([
      { id: "delete", rowAction: "delete" },
    ]);
  });

  test("a bulk action that points at a navigate row action is rejected", () => {
    const feature = defineFeature("bulk-on-navigate", (r) => {
      r.crud("task", taskEntity, { write: openAccess, read: openAccess });
      r.screen({
        id: "task-list",
        type: "entityList",
        entity: "task",
        columns: ["title"],
        rowActions: [{ kind: "navigate", id: "open", label: "Open", screen: "task-list" }],
        bulkActions: [{ id: "open", rowAction: "open" }],
        access: openAccess.access,
      });
    });
    expect(() => validateBoot([feature])).toThrow(
      /bulk action "open" points at rowAction "open" of kind "navigate"/,
    );
  });

  test("a pinned column needs table.pinning", () => {
    expect(() => validateBoot([featureWithBlock({ columnPicker: true, resizing: true })])).toThrow(
      /column "title" is pinned but table\.pinning is not enabled/,
    );
  });

  test("width and minWidth need table.resizing", () => {
    expect(() => validateBoot([featureWithBlock({ columnPicker: true, pinning: true })])).toThrow(
      /column "title" sets width but table\.resizing is not enabled/,
    );
  });

  test("a misspelled table key is rejected with the allowed keys", () => {
    expect(() => validateBoot([featureWithBlock({ rememberStatee: true })])).toThrow(
      /unknown key\(s\) "rememberStatee"\. Allowed keys: rememberState, resetAll, columnPicker, density, pinning, resizing, keyboardNavigation, export/,
    );
  });

  test("a hidden column needs the column picker", () => {
    expect(() => validateBoot([featureWithBlock({ rememberState: true, resetAll: true })])).toThrow(
      /column "estimateHours" is hidden but table\.columnPicker is not enabled/,
    );
  });

  test("a density outside the union is rejected", () => {
    expect(() =>
      validateBoot([featureWithBlock({ columnPicker: true, density: { default: "tight" } })]),
    ).toThrow(/table\.density\.default is "tight"/);
  });

  test("an export row limit above the hard cap is rejected", () => {
    expect(() =>
      validateBoot([
        featureWithBlock({ columnPicker: true, export: { xlsx: true, maxRows: 100001 } }),
      ]),
    ).toThrow(/table\.export\.maxRows is 100001 .* at most 100000/);
  });
});
```

### src/__tests__/workload.integration.test.ts

```ts
import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test } from "bun:test";
import { createTestUser, testTenantId } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/seeding";
import { setupTestStack, type TestStack } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-testing/stack";
import { createTaskBoardFeature } from "../feature";

type ListAggregateResult = {
  readonly groups: readonly { key: unknown; count: number; measures: readonly unknown[] }[];
};

let stack: TestStack;
const user = createTestUser({ roles: ["User"], tenantId: testTenantId(1) });

const TASKS = [
  { title: "Quarterly VAT filing", assignee: "Ines", estimateHours: 6 },
  { title: "Prepare audit", assignee: "Ines", estimateHours: 24 },
  { title: "Plan offsite", assignee: "Mara", estimateHours: 7 },
] as const;

beforeAll(async () => {
  stack = await setupTestStack({ features: [createTaskBoardFeature()], systemHooks: [] });
  for (const task of TASKS) {
    await stack.http.writeOk("task-board:write:task:create", task, user);
  }
});

afterAll(async () => {
  await stack.cleanup();
});

describe("hand-written list query with aggregate", () => {
  test("groups by assignee with the server count and estimate sum", async () => {
    const result = await stack.http.queryOk<ListAggregateResult>(
      "task-board:query:task:workload",
      { aggregate: { groupBy: "assignee", measures: [{ field: "estimateHours", kind: "sum" }] } },
      user,
    );
    expect(result.groups.map(({ key, count, measures }) => ({ key, count, measures }))).toEqual([
      { key: "Ines", count: 2, measures: [30] },
      { key: "Mara", count: 1, measures: [7] },
    ]);
  });

  test("the totals answer follows the list filter", async () => {
    const result = await stack.http.queryOk<ListAggregateResult>(
      "task-board:query:task:workload",
      {
        filters: [{ field: "estimateHours", op: "lte", value: 7 }],
        aggregate: { measures: [{ field: "estimateHours", kind: "sum" }] },
      },
      user,
    );
    expect(result.groups.map((group) => group.measures)).toEqual([[13]]);
  });

  test("without aggregate the same query lists rows", async () => {
    const list = await stack.http.queryOk<{ rows: { title: string }[] }>(
      "task-board:query:task:workload",
      { sort: "title" },
      user,
    );
    expect(list.rows.map((row) => row.title)).toEqual([
      "Plan offsite",
      "Prepare audit",
      "Quarterly VAT filing",
    ]);
  });
});
```

### src/feature.ts

```ts
import {
  answerListAggregate,
  buildEntityTable,
  createEventStoreExecutor,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/db";
import {
  createDateField,
  createEntity,
  createNumberField,
  createSelectField,
  createTextField,
  defineFeature,
  entityListSchema,
  type FeatureDefinition,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/engine";
import type { ListTableOptions } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/ui-types";
import { z } from "zod";

export const taskEntity = createEntity({
  table: "read_list_table_tasks",
  fields: {
    title: createTextField({
      personal: false,
      reason: "is_business_data",
      required: true,
      searchable: true,
      sortable: true,
    }),
    status: createSelectField({
      options: ["open", "inProgress", "blocked", "done"] as const,
      default: "open",
      sortable: true,
      filterable: true,
    }),
    priority: createSelectField({
      options: ["low", "medium", "high"] as const,
      default: "medium",
      sortable: true,
      filterable: true,
    }),
    dueDate: createDateField({ sortable: true }),
    assignee: createTextField({ personal: false, reason: "is_business_data", sortable: true }),
    estimateHours: createNumberField({ sortable: true, filterable: true }),
  },
});

export const openAccess = {
  access: {
    openToAll: { reason: "recipe: any signed-in user manages the tasks; no per-user ownership" },
  },
} as const;

// Overridable so a test can feed the boot validator a block that must be rejected.
export function createTaskBoardFeature(
  taskTable: ListTableOptions = {
    rememberState: true,
    resetAll: true,
    columnPicker: true,
    density: { default: "comfortable", userChoice: true },
    pinning: true,
    resizing: true,
    keyboardNavigation: true,
    export: { xlsx: true, maxRows: 5000 },
    grouping: { field: "status", collapsedWhen: "done", userChoice: true, fields: ["priority"] },
    totals: [{ field: "estimateHours", kind: "sum" }],
  },
): FeatureDefinition {
  return defineFeature("task-board", (r) => {
    r.crud("task", taskEntity, { write: openAccess, read: openAccess });

    r.screen({
      id: "task-list",
      type: "entityList",
      entity: "task",
      columns: [
        // Starts pinned left; width and minWidth are start values for resizing.
        { field: "title", pinned: "left", width: 280, minWidth: 160 },
        "status",
        "priority",
        { field: "dueDate", hideOnNarrow: true },
        { field: "assignee", hideOnNarrow: true },
        // Starts hidden; the user can add it back in the view menu.
        { field: "estimateHours", hidden: true, hideOnNarrow: true },
      ],
      facets: { status: { display: "chips" }, priority: {}, estimateHours: { display: "range" } },
      defaultSort: { field: "dueDate", dir: "asc" },
      searchable: true,
      table: taskTable,
      rowActions: [
        { kind: "navigate", id: "open", label: "Open", screen: "task-edit", rowClick: true },
        {
          kind: "writeHandler",
          id: "delete",
          label: "Delete",
          handler: "task-board:write:task:delete",
          style: "danger",
          // Done tasks are skipped by the bulk run and counted as skipped.
          visible: { field: "status", ne: "done" },
        },
      ],
      // Row checkboxes and a selection bar; each selected row gets its own delete write.
      bulkActions: [{ id: "delete", rowAction: "delete" }],
      access: openAccess.access,
    });

    r.screen({
      id: "task-edit",
      type: "entityEdit",
      entity: "task",
      dormant: true,
      listScreenId: "task-list",
      layout: {
        sections: [
          {
            columns: 2,
            fields: ["title", "assignee", "status", "priority", "dueDate", "estimateHours"],
          },
        ],
      },
    });

    // The same block works on a list over any query.
    r.queryHandler({
      name: "task:overdue",
      schema: z.object({}),
      handler: async () => ({
        rows: [{ id: "t1", title: "Quarterly VAT filing", assignee: "Ines", daysLate: 3 }],
        nextCursor: null,
      }),
      access: openAccess.access,
      outputSchema: z.object({
        rows: z.array(
          z.object({
            id: z.string(),
            title: z.string(),
            assignee: z.string(),
            daysLate: z.number(),
          }),
        ),
        nextCursor: z.string().nullable(),
      }),
    });

    r.screen({
      id: "task-overdue",
      type: "projectionList",
      query: "task-board:query:task:overdue",
      columns: ["title", "assignee", "daysLate"],
      table: { rememberState: true, density: { userChoice: true } },
    });

    // A hand-written list query keeps grouping and totals when it accepts
    // `aggregate` (entityListSchema carries it) and answers it on the server.
    const taskExecutor = createEventStoreExecutor(
      buildEntityTable("task", taskEntity),
      taskEntity,
      {
        entityName: "task",
      },
    );
    r.queryHandler({
      name: "task:workload",
      schema: entityListSchema,
      handler: async (query, ctx) => {
        const parentVisibility = { entities: ctx.registry.getAllEntities() };
        const listPayload = query.payload;
        if (listPayload.aggregate !== undefined) {
          return answerListAggregate(
            taskExecutor,
            { ...listPayload, aggregate: listPayload.aggregate },
            query.user,
            ctx.db,
            { parentVisibility },
            {
              entity: taskEntity,
              resolveEntity: (name) => ctx.registry.getEntity(name),
              viewer: { user: query.user, parentVisibility },
            },
          );
        }
        return taskExecutor.list(listPayload, query.user, ctx.db, { parentVisibility });
      },
      access: openAccess.access,
    });

    r.screen({
      id: "task-workload",
      type: "projectionList",
      query: "task-board:query:task:workload",
      columns: ["title", "assignee", "status", "estimateHours"],
      defaultSort: { field: "title", dir: "asc" },
      table: {
        grouping: { field: "assignee" },
        totals: [{ field: "estimateHours", kind: "sum" }],
      },
    });

    r.nav({ id: "tasks", label: "task-board:nav.tasks", icon: "list", order: 10 });
    r.nav({
      id: "task-list",
      label: "task-board:nav.list",
      parent: "task-board:nav:tasks",
      screen: "task-board:screen:task-list",
      order: 10,
    });
    r.nav({
      id: "task-overdue",
      label: "task-board:nav.overdue",
      parent: "task-board:nav:tasks",
      screen: "task-board:screen:task-overdue",
      order: 20,
    });
    r.nav({
      id: "task-workload",
      label: "task-board:nav.workload",
      parent: "task-board:nav:tasks",
      screen: "task-board:screen:task-workload",
      order: 30,
    });
  });
}
```
